title: Conditional routing and join correctness conformance bundle
commands: uv run pytest -q tests/test_dag_route_decision.py tests/test_dag_join_decision.py tests/test_project_dag_join_policies.py

command_results.command: uv run pytest -q tests/test_dag_route_decision.py tests/test_dag_join_decision.py tests/test_project_dag_join_policies.py

conformance_items.requirement: exclusive route selection is deterministic and fail-closed on ambiguity
conformance_items.evidence: tests/test_dag_route_decision.py::test_route_modes_have_closed_deterministic_semantics covers exclusive PASS, exclusive ambiguous BLOCKED, and no-match BLOCKED.

conformance_items.requirement: route conditions evaluate typed receipt/result fields only
conformance_items.evidence: tests/test_dag_route_decision.py::test_route_condition_uses_strict_typed_values and rejection tests for expressions/reserved/untyped forms.

conformance_items.requirement: route receipts are replayable and tamper-evident
skipped branches contribute terminal state to joins
conformance_items.evidence: tests/test_project_dag_join_policies.py::test_conditional_skip_contributes_and_minimum_join_releases records skipped branch terminal contribution before join release.

conformance_items.requirement: all_success joins block on unselected branches without ready-queue stall
join decisions are deterministic, hash-bound, and replayable
conformance_items.evidence: tests/test_dag_join_decision.py validates join decisions, terminal contributions, immutable receipt writes, replay, and failure vocabulary.

conformance_items.requirement: join timeout and late contribution handling are terminal and non-hanging
conformance_items.evidence: tests/test_project_dag_join_policies.py timeout cases prove timed-out/cancelled contributions and late terminal contribution ignore behavior.

proves: Tau has a committed P1 conformance bundle for closed typed route semantics, fail-closed ambiguous/no-match routing, skipped-branch terminal contribution, explicit join policies, non-hanging join timeout behavior, and replayable/tamper-evident route/join receipts.
